reviews.t: Amazing and so easy to apply!
reviews.x: Amazing!! I love how natural these are yet noticeable. The magnetic eye liner is amazing and makes application soooo much easier!! Very happy with my purchase and will continue to buy from this seller! Thank u.
There was very little product in the liner tube and what WAS there came out clumpy and fell off . I will be returning them . I find it very hard to believe anyone got theirs to work !
I absolutely love these lashes, they are so natural with a little spice very pretty on. I’d definitely buy them again❤️

reviews.t: Lashes are a great length, but.......
reviews.x: I ordered this set for the lashes since I already have some liner.  I am very glad I do have the liner because the one that comes with this set is crap.  I made sure my eyes were clean and dry.  I read the directions on the back of the package... shake the liner 10 times (I made sure I shook it more than that), apply a thick layer and let dry a few seconds (it took longer than that)  apply another thick coat then get the lash and apply it to the liner area.  gently press down. Very simple right?

reviews.t: TL;DR Not worth hassle, better off with glue ons
reviews.x: Bought these as a test to see if the magnetic eyelashes are worth it. I’d never tried them before and figured, what the hell. As a long time eyelash fan, I completely understand the idea of spending hours on make up just to have that final step of putting glue-on lashes ruin it all, they’re not easy... so the appeal was here to give this new way a try.  Let me be frank, they’re terrible and not worth the money. I’ll take my chances on the glue...  To explain why... I can’t speak to all brands bu

reviews.t: Lashes fine line or no go
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:c349703a83039eae37e744e1534bfed0]] The look of her lashes is nice. I like the three different styles. Unfortunately the liner is almost nonexistent and very hard to apply. It’s more like the gel kind of eyeliner. It doesn’t have a typical brush and I’m sure that’s because of the type of Eyeliner it is. The liner is very dry and that’s what makes it hard to put on. I couldn’t even get very much out which made it even harder

I am a natural blonde and have always had thin, sparse lashes, so I used the false eyelashes & glue for years. It got to be too much hassle, so when the magnetic lashes came on the market I was thrilled - if they really worked. Well I can personally tell you they are very secure and easy to apply. My daughter & I both love the Lamix brand. Far superior than other brands. We are very happy to be able to always look glamorous now!

The eyelashes are pretty and natural looking. The eyeliner is terrible! I made sure to shake it before I opened it and when I did the eyeliner was clumpy and seemed dried out and the brush was messed up. The pic is after my attempt to fix the brush. I tried it on my hand anyway and the eyelashes barely stuck. I was able to blow the lashes off my hand by just barely blowing on them. I'm not happy with it.

I was so excited to try these lashes.  Thought the ease of the magnet would be so much better than the glue.  When I tried to apply, the liner is NOT liquid but was more like a powder or in my mind all dried up!!  The lashes are a great quality but I would not recommend based on the glue situation; how long have these been sitting on the shelf??

reviews.t: Does not work even a little bit
reviews.x: Terrible product. I really wanted this to work. I shook the bottle 20-30 times as directed and I was able to paint a line but the lashes did not stick at all. I tried adding another coat of liner and every time I dipped the brush in and pulled it out the brush bristles would bend the wrong way and frayed something awful! Just terrible.

reviews.t: I really was hoping for the best
reviews.x: I was so excited to see something that would make it easier to have beautiful full lashes, unfortunately, the product didn't work. Pretty lashes with the kit but the liner was dried up and clumpy, I was scared to try to put it on my lids. I did try one and one lash, but no go. Hopefully this product will be perfected over time.

Can’t give less than one star but wish I could. I was not able to see if the product worked because the eyeliner was dust when I took the brush out of the tube, what a rip off. Don’t have the time to go to post office to ship back so I lose all the way around  Don’t purchase you definitely get what you pay for

Love them! I need to practice on applying the eyeliner, I suck at it. The product does what it's meant to do. I love how natural they look, and love the option of gleaming out on the 3rd size, but they're not over the top, like some false lashes. I only wish the eyeliner was a pen application.

Easy to use and the options from low key to evening lashes keep my look different for all occasions. The magnetic liner is super easy to use and since my skin is very oily I recommend priming your lids prior to application so you will get the full use of your lashes

reviews.t: Eyeliner doesn't seem to work. Disappointed.
reviews.x: The elashes look great! The eyeliner doesn't seem to flow evenly & eyelash ends didn't connect with magnetic eyeliner at the ends. So the lashes stuck on except for the ends. Bought them for a special occasion ended up not using them. Disappointed

I cant believe it works! Magnetic Liner is the best thing EVER!!Yay no more glue!  I stopped wearing lashes because it was such a pain and took me forever to get it right, these lashes go right on with hardly any adjustment.  LOVE THEM!

The thee pair of lashes are beautiful but I cannot get them to stick to my lids.  I have tried multiple times and even experimented on the top of my hand but no success.  I have emailed the company so I am waiting for a response.

Just received the lashes and eyeliner (arrival was a few days later than expected). When I went to use the eyeliner it was completely dried up. The lashes are beautiful but don’t know how they’ll work as the eyeliner is unusable.

Eyeliner is dry. It doesn’t matter how much you shake the bottle, the product comes out in crumbles. I still made an attempt to apply it. As a result I got this product all over my face and in my eyes.
Super fast shipping! Product was in perfect condition and exactly as described! The 3 pairs of lashes are perfect for different occasions including daily and going out!! So excited to try them all!!
Worst purchase. The magnetic eyeliner was so thick that I couldn’t get a good line, and as soon as it dries it flakes off and the eyelashes fall off. I hate that I wasted money on this product.
The lashes are great! 3 different styles. The eyeliner on the other hand  was dried out when it arrived. I tried to revive it and dries quickly and flakes off nearly an hour after application.
The lashes themselves were really pretty, however the eyeliner was very hard and lumpy, as if it was old and dried out mascara. Therefore, I end up using regular lash glue.
The lashes are great! Three different lengths that are great for everyday to formal outings, easy to put on. Only negative is that my eyeliner was dry when I received it.
I love these lashes. One of the best magnetic lashes I’ve tried to date. I love that this package comes with 3 different sets of lashes. One for work and 2 for play ❤️

claims.text: Many reviewers report the magnetic eyeliner is dried out, clumpy, or nearly empty, making the lashes fail to stick.
Reviewers frequently praise the lashes for looking natural and pretty.
Several customers find the lashes easy to apply and the magnetic system convenient.
Some reviewers appreciate the multiple lash styles/options for different looks.
A few reviewers note the liner application is difficult or awkward, such as the brush or pen format.
